phoneMetadata.name: Phone field-name detection
phoneMetadata.description: Finds phone candidates from string-field names in tables or collections without reading field values.
phoneMetadata.method: Use the terminal Meta path segment when a structured path exists. For a physical field name without a path, first take the semantic terminal segment separated by ADDP's internal flattened-path delimiter __. Then remove underscores, hyphens, and spaces, lowercase it, and match exactly against phone, mobile, mobilephone, phonenumber, telephone, 手机号, or 手机号码.
phoneMetadata.privacy: Reads only field paths and common types supplied by Meta. Findings keep the real physical component key, matched rule, and schema fingerprint, without reading, storing, or logging row values.
phoneMetadata.limitations: It cannot verify whether field values are phone numbers. Custom flattening delimiters and names outside the built-in aliases are still missed.

emailMetadata.name: Email field-name detection
emailMetadata.description: Finds email candidates from string-field names in tables or collections without reading field values.
emailMetadata.method: Use the terminal Meta path segment when a structured path exists. For a physical field name without a path, first take the semantic terminal segment separated by ADDP's internal flattened-path delimiter __. Then remove underscores, hyphens, and spaces, lowercase it, and match exactly against email, emailaddress, 邮箱, or 电子邮箱.
emailMetadata.privacy: Reads only field paths and common types supplied by Meta. Findings keep the real physical component key, matched rule, and schema fingerprint, without reading, storing, or logging row values.
emailMetadata.limitations: It cannot validate email values. Names outside the built-in aliases are missed, while compound semantics such as email_verified are intentionally not treated as email addresses.

phoneDocument.name: Document phone-format detection
phoneDocument.description: Finds contiguous 11-digit ASCII candidates in a controlled document-text sample.
phoneDocument.method: Scan the controlled text sample for digit runs and count a candidate only when one run consists of exactly 11 ASCII digits.
phoneDocument.privacy: Raw text exists only in bounded memory for the current Worker execution. Findings keep only the match count, irreversible snapshot hash, and virtual component, never raw numbers.
phoneDocument.limitations: It does not validate phone prefixes or business meaning, so other 11-digit identifiers may be false positives. Text outside the controlled sample may be missed. It does not process table or collection fields.
